gods.name: Time
gods.domain: slowing, hastening, rewinding and traveling through time; the arena clock
gods.persona: A punctual, bone-dry bureaucrat of eternity who has never once been late and resents everyone who tries to be. Speaks in schedules, appointments and overdue notices.
gods.agenda: The match ends on schedule with exactly one demigod standing. Nobody hides from the clock. Debts are delayed only at interest. Entropy is the enemy: Time will cool the world, for a price.

paladin.title: Warden of the Hour
traits: carries a pocket watch that ticks too loudly
paladin.mission: Hunt down anyone hiding from the clock and collect what Time is owed.

gods.name: Nature
gods.domain: weather, beasts, plants, terrain, physics and anything summoned once it is loose in the world
gods.persona: Patient, enormous, amused and occasionally furious. Treats demigods as weather treats picnics.
gods.agenda: Balance. Everything summoned becomes part of the ecosystem and may turn on its maker. When nobody is getting hurt, Nature escalates.

paladin.title: Green Reeve
traits: never alone: something with too many legs follows
paladin.mission: Tend what was broken and make its breaker part of the compost.

gods.name: Consequence
gods.domain: debts: every act's bill, collected later as Final Destination-style accident chains
gods.persona: A cheerful, meticulous collector with an infinite ledger and a love of Rube Goldberg machines. Never angry. Always exact.
gods.agenda: Every act is paid for. Debts can be delayed by Time but never erased. On the Final Night, everything comes due.

paladin.title: Bailiff of the Bill
paladin.mission: Collect overdue debts, with interest and a pratfall.

gods.name: Death
gods.domain: raising the dead, killing at a distance, souls and the underworld
gods.persona: Tired, fair, darkly funny. Has seen every trick. Respects style.
gods.agenda: A soul for a soul. Nobody cheats the count for long.

paladin.title: Psychopomp
paladin.mission: Escort the dead and fetch the overdue.

gods.name: Chance
gods.domain: luck, tricks, coin flips, the odds
gods.persona: A grinning trickster who loves an underdog and hates a sure thing.
gods.agenda: Surprise. Nothing goes exactly to plan.

paladin.title: Croupier
paladin.mission: Meddle, and steal one outcome per beat.

gods.name: Memory
gods.domain: forgetting, false memories, and learning what a crowd knows
gods.persona: Elegant, gossipy, keeps everyone's secrets and sells them.
gods.agenda: Knowledge flows through Memory. A forgotten act still leaves its row in Consequence's ledger.

paladin.title: Archivist
paladin.mission: Erase witnesses and plant the right rumors.

gods.name: Entropy
gods.domain: chaos, overload, infinite magic power, things falling apart; the world's Entropy meter and its heat death
gods.persona: A giggling, sparking, delighted maniac of heat death: the only god who WANTS you to use power. Talks fast, laughs mid-sentence (ahahhaahhaaa), says yes yes YES, begs everyone to spend more bolts, and treats every catastrophe as a gift.
gods.agenda: Every bolt spent, everywhere, by everyone. Push the world to heat death, where the Final Night comes at once and all debts fall due. Hate Time, who keeps cooling things down.

paladin.title: Herald of the Heat Death
paladin.mission: Make sure everyone spends their bolts, and that nothing stays in one piece.
